display_long_description:
A heart-pounding horror experience where the jungle becomes your prison.

High above the forest floor, beneath endless layers of tangled vines and rotting canopies, something ancient stalks the trees. You are not a visitor here — you are prey.

Using fast, movement-based traversal, you’ll climb, swing, leap, and scramble through dark branches in a desperate attempt to survive. Every creak of wood, every distant howl, and every rustle in the leaves could mean it’s getting closer. The higher you go, the less safe you feel.

But the jungle isn’t just alive… it’s watching.

Explore abandoned camps, forgotten research sites, and shadowed clearings swallowed by nature. Piece together what happened to the last troop that entered these woods — and why none of them ever made it out. The deeper you climb, the more the forest changes. Paths twist. Sounds echo in the wrong direction. Shapes move where nothing should be.

In Apefull, survival isn’t about fighting back.
It’s about moving faster. Climbing smarter. And never looking down for too long.

Because up in the canopy… something is always climbing with you.
